definitions.explanation: A shop that sells flowers and floral arrangements. Can also refer to the person who owns or works at such a shop.

examples.english: I bought roses at the flower shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{花屋|はなや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a flower shop in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{花屋|はなや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.english: Flower shops get crowded before Mother's Day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花屋|はなや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花束|はなたば}→花束：03135_hanataba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a birthday bouquet at the neighborhood flower shop.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop/seller). Refers to both the flower shop and the florist who runs it.

FORMAL ALTERNATIVE:
{花屋|はなや}さん (with さん) is the polite/friendly way to refer to a florist or flower shop. More formally: フラワー⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧.
